name: drive
author: coldsoldr
description: An oversampled soft-clip overdrive, true stereo: drive (0..+36 dB), tone (a tilt about 1 kHz, centre flat), bias (odd to even harmonics), mix; fn + blue input gain (-6..+6 dB, shift + fn + blue fine). Port of coldsoldr's te-op1-cfw drive (kennel plugin ports/knl/drive 0.2), GPL-3.0-or-later; the halfband's coefficients are Mutable Instruments Clouds' (Emilie Gillet, MIT, LICENSE-MIT).
